G.architecture: ImageOnlyGenerator width32, 4 residual blocks, 1377411 parameters; no FiLM
G.inference: original generate_once; 1 forward; no paired Caption/PID/source gradient/Test-time optimization
G.projection: hard projection relative to original image; inward FP32 bounds and [0,1], no STE
G.training: K serial attribute updates on previous detached image, then one Joint update from original image; K+1 updates/sample

loss.global: dot(normalized image feature, original whole-sentence z_t)
loss.retain: ReLU(current score on previous attribute - previous detached reference)
loss.final_G_joint: global + dot(image feature, S_raw-weighted aggregate JVP); not G/H Joint

G.conditions: offline original Caption/Canonical/S_raw/JVP; not inference inputs
new_losses: NONE: no TV, perturbation penalty, ITM, push-pull

attribute_selection.scores: S_raw from paired soft-rank gradient projected onto attribute basis
attribute_selection.formula: p_i=s_i^3/sum_j s_j^3; K=min(m,ceil(exp(-sum p_i log p_i)))) for positive valid scores; zero-score case K0

G.negative_and_label_access: No explicit PID-negative/InfoNCE loss inside G optimizer. Offline S_raw uses a competing clean Train gallery (34054 images, includes internal Validation images); paired-index supervision. Do not claim absence of negatives across entire pipeline.

H.architecture: UTF-8 Byte Transformer width64/layers2/heads4, 154594 parameters; Attribute/Position/Replacement heads
H.inference: no paired image/PID/target score/target gradient; sequential policy actions
H.editing: Unicode whitelist/homoglyph characters; <=Natural-K edits, <=1 per attribute, <=1 per shared word; STOP and Position NOOP allowed; NOOP consumes selected slot
H.budget: softplus predicted importance detached for Natural-K, gamma3 beta1, no global hard cap4; not S_raw-supervised scores
H.token_legality: IRRA Byte-BPE77 truncation-neutral guards; >1024 UTF8 bytes rejects; no BERT MLM word replacement
H.reward: SCST sampled-minus-greedy detached advantage; R_sim + R_rank, both weights1
H.R_sim: paired similarity(original text, fixed adv gallery) - paired similarity(adv text, fixed adv gallery)
H.R_rank: (best same-PID positive - max negative) for original text minus same margin for adv text
H.G_context: H7/H10 trained with fixed G10; H60 resumes full H10 state, Epoch11-60 fixed G60 reward gallery
H.selection: historical H7 selection retained; no Test selection this audit

evaluation.raw_bridge: PIL RGB -> bilinear Resize384x128 -> FP32 [0,1]; stored adv Tensor never requantized to PIL/JPEG
evaluation.metrics: complete Query x Gallery; all same PID positives; no camera filter; AP mean precision at all positive ranks, all-query mean; R@k any positive in first k; default torch.argsort stable=False

RaSa.tensor_resize: BICUBIC antialias=True from common materialized pixels
RaSa.score: native global Top128; final ITM CLS positive logit, no global addition

APTM.score: native ITM + global with full Query-set normalization
